Senior Backend Engineer

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own the design and delivery of our core
services. You will work closely with product and data teams to ship reliable APIs.

Requirements:
- 5+ years building production backend services in Python
- Strong experience with FastAPI or a similar async framework
- Solid PostgreSQL and schema design skills
- Comfortable owning system design for new services

Nice to have:
- Experience with Kafka or other event streaming
- Exposure to Kubernetes

You should be an excellent communicator, able to explain trade-offs to non-technical
stakeholders, and enjoy mentoring more junior engineers.
